## What changed

Describe the change clearly.

## Why

Explain the problem, evidence, or project need behind it.

## Validation

List the commands and tests used to verify the change.

## Safety and licensing checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or proprietary material are included.
- [ ] New behavior has tests or a documented reason why tests do not apply.
- [ ] Permission changes and destructive actions are documented.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries are updated where needed.
- [ ] The contribution is compatible with the repository license.
